newsitem.title: CHINA: China to export railway products to U.S.
newsitem.headline: China to export railway products to U.S.

text.p: The China National Railway Locomotive & Rolling Stock Industry Corp has signed an accord with U.S. firm Barber Truck International to export railway products to the United States, the official China Daily said on Wednesday.
Under the agreement the Chinese firm will export 200 sets of freight car side frames and bolsters, as well as main locomotive and rolling stock parts, the newspaper said.
It gave no value for the sale.

The agreement, signed in Beijing on Tuesday, marks the first time a Chinese firm has exported locomotive and rolling stock parts to the United States after receiving quality verification from the Associaton of American Railroads, the China Daily said.
